<FILENAME>n4863_x28exh10-4.htm
<DESCRIPTION>ROYALTY REPURCHASE, WARRANT EXERCISE AND NOTE SATISFACTION AGREEMENT, DATED SEPTEMBER 30, 2026, BY AND BETWEEN MINERALRITE CORPORATION AND ABSTRACT CONCEPTS 1618 LLC.
<TEXT>
<HTML>
<HEAD>
<TITLE></TITLE>
</HEAD>
<BODY>


<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: right"><B>Exhibit 10.4</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>ROYALTY REPURCHASE, WARRANT EXERCISE AND<BR>
NOTE SATISFACTION AGREEMENT</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">This Royalty Repurchase, Warrant Exercise and Note
Satisfaction Agreement (this &ldquo;Agreement&rdquo;) is entered into as of September 30, 2026 (the &ldquo;Closing Date&rdquo;) and shall
be effective on such date, by and between MineralRite Corporation, a Texas corporation (&ldquo;RITE&rdquo;), and Abstract Concepts 1618
LLC (&ldquo;Abstract&rdquo;). RITE and Abstract are each a &ldquo;Party&rdquo; and collectively the &ldquo;Parties.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>RECITALS</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>WHEREAS,</B> RITE has issued to Abstract a promissory
note in the original principal amount of $106,724,942 (the &ldquo;Note&rdquo;) as consideration for RITE&rsquo;s repurchase of 3,919,388
Series NMC Preferred shares;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>WHEREAS</B>, Abstract holds an option to repurchase
from RITE the derivative, fixed, terminating production payment royalty originally transferred by Abstract to RITE pursuant to the Option
to Repurchase Agreement effective October 6, 2025 (the &ldquo;Abstract Royalty&rdquo;);</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>WHEREAS,</B> Commodity Capital Advisors LLC (&ldquo;Commodity&rdquo;),
an entity managed by Abstract, holds the option to repurchase from RITE the derivative, fixed, terminating production payment royalty
originally transferred by Abstract to RITE on behalf of Commodity pursuant to the Option to Repurchase Agreement effective October 7,
2025 (the &ldquo;Commodity Royalty&rdquo;), and Commodity, acting through Abstract as its manager, desires to exercise that option, with
Abstract funding the repurchase on Commodity&rsquo;s behalf as part of the transactions contemplated hereby;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>WHEREAS</B>, Abstract desires to exercise all 47,600
Series D warrants and all 6,900,000 Series NMC warrants held by Abstract, and, as manager of Commodity, to fund and effect on Commodity&rsquo;s
behalf the exercise of all 5,900 Series D warrants held by Commodity; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>WHEREAS</B>, RITE agrees to accept application
of the Note as payment of the foregoing royalty repurchase prices and warrant exercise prices, including the amounts payable by Commodity
that Abstract is funding on Commodity&rsquo;s behalf.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>NOW, THEREFORE</B>, the Parties agree as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>1. EXERCISE OF ABSTRACT ROYALTY OPTION</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">Abstract hereby exercises the option to repurchase
the Abstract Royalty. The Parties agree that, through September 30, 2026, the Accreted Repurchase Price under the applicable option agreement
is $1,641,254. Abstract directs RITE to apply $1,641,254 of the Note as payment. RITE accepts such application as payment in full and
hereby transfers, assigns and reconveys the Abstract Royalty to Abstract free and clear of liens created by RITE. The option is fully
exercised and terminated upon Closing.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>2. EXERCISE OF COMMODITY ROYALTY OPTION</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">Commodity, acting through Abstract as its manager
pursuant to the Authorization to Exercise Option to Repurchase and Consent executed contemporaneously herewith, exercises its option to
repurchase the Commodity Royalty. The Accreted Repurchase Price through September 30, 2026 is $246,188. Abstract directs RITE to apply
$246,188 of the Note on behalf of Commodity as payment in full. RITE accepts such application as full payment of Commodity&rsquo;s repurchase
price and hereby transfers, assigns and reconveys the Commodity Royalty to Commodity free and clear of liens created by RITE. The Commodity
option is fully exercised and terminated upon Closing.</P>


<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 1; Options: NewSection; Value: 1 -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 10pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>3. EXERCISE OF SERIES D WARRANTS</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 3pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>3.1 Abstract Series D Warrants</B>. Abstract
hereby irrevocably exercises all 47,600 Series D warrants held by Abstract at the contractual exercise price of $25.00 per warrant, for
an aggregate exercise price of $1,190,000. Abstract directs RITE to apply $1,190,000 of the Note as payment in full. RITE accepts such
payment and shall issue to Abstract the securities issuable upon exercise in accordance with the governing Series D warrant instruments.
The exercised warrants shall be surrendered and cancelled at Closing.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 3pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>3.2 Commodity Series D Warrants</B>. Commodity,
acting through Abstract as its manager, hereby irrevocably exercises all 5,900 Series D warrants held by Commodity at the contractual
exercise price of $25.00 per warrant, for an aggregate exercise price of $147,500. Abstract directs RITE to apply $147,500 of the Note
on behalf of Commodity as payment in full. RITE accepts such payment and shall issue to Commodity the securities issuable upon exercise
in accordance with the governing Series D warrant instruments. The exercised warrants shall be surrendered and cancelled at Closing.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>4. EXERCISE OF SERIES NMC WARRANTS</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">Abstract hereby irrevocably exercises all 6,900,000
Series NMC warrants held by Abstract at the contractual exercise price of $15.00 per warrant, for an aggregate exercise price of $103,500,000.
Abstract directs RITE to apply $103,500,000 of the Note as payment in full. RITE accepts such payment and shall issue to Abstract the
securities issuable upon exercise in accordance with the governing Series NMC warrant instruments. The exercised warrants shall be surrendered
and cancelled at Closing.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>5. APPLICATION AND COMPLETE SATISFACTION OF NOTE</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: bottom; background-color: White">
    <TD STYLE="font-weight: bold; text-align: left; padding-left: 5.4pt">TOTAL APPLIED:</TD><TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: left">$</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: right">106,724,942</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left">&nbsp;</TD></TR>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">The Parties acknowledge that the total applied equals
the original principal amount of the Note. The Parties agree that the consideration exchanged under the integrated transaction constitutes
full, complete and sufficient satisfaction of all amounts due under the Note. At Closing, the Note shall be deemed fully paid, satisfied,
discharged, surrendered and cancelled with a zero balance.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>6. SIMULTANEOUS CLOSING; BOOKS AND RECORDS</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 3pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>6.1 Integrated Closing; Closing Mechanics.</B>
The royalty transfers, warrant exercises, application of the Note, issuance of the securities underlying the warrants, and cancellation
of the Note shall occur contemporaneously as one integrated Closing. RITE is authorized to issue all appropriate transfer-agent instructions
and the Parties are authorized to record the transactions on their books and records. Each Party shall execute any customary exercise
notice, stock power or other ministerial instrument reasonably necessary to evidence the transactions.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 3pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>6.2 Corporate Authorizations; Effect of Processing
Delay.</B> RITE shall take all commercially reasonable and necessary corporate actions to cause the appropriate authorizations for the
securities contemplated hereby to be filed and become effective. The issuance of any securities contemplated hereby shall be made when
and to the extent such securities are duly authorized and available for issuance; provided, however, that any delay in the effectiveness
of such authorization shall not delay, invalidate or otherwise affect the Closing or the effectiveness of the transactions contemplated
by this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>7. AUTHORITY; ENTIRE AGREEMENT; GOVERNING LAW</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">Each Party represents that it has authority to execute
and perform this Agreement. Abstract represents that it is the lawful holder of the 47,600 Series D warrants and 6,900,000 Series NMC
warrants exercised by it herein and that it is authorized, as manager of Commodity, to act on Commodity&rsquo;s behalf with respect to
the Commodity Royalty option and the 5,900 Series D warrants held by Commodity. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between
the Parties concerning its subject matter and may be amended only in writing signed by both Parties. Texas law governs. Exclusive venue
shall lie in the state or federal courts located in Dallas County, Texas. Counterpart and electronic signatures are effective as originals.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>
